oracle_text: Commander creatures you own have "Whenever this creature attacks a player, if no opponent has more life than that player, for each opponent, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token that's tapped and attacking that opponent."

oracle_text:

Vigilance

oracle_text:
Flying

oracle_text:

name: HYDRA Troopers
oracle_text: When this creature enters, create a tapped 2/1 black Villain creature token with menace if there are two or more creature cards in your graveyard. Otherwise, mill two cards. (Put the top two cards of your library into your graveyard.)

oracle_text:

+2: You may sacrifice an artifact or discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
0: Create a 3/2 colorless Vehicle artifact token with crew 1.

name: Doubling Season
oracle_text:
If an effect would create one or more tokens under your control, it creates twice that many of those tokens instead.
If an effect would put one or more counters on a permanent you control, it puts twice that many of those counters on that permanent instead.

name: Setzer, Wandering Gambler
oracle_text:

Whenever a Vehicle you control deals combat damage to a player, flip a coin.
Whenever you win a coin flip, create two tapped Treasure tokens.

name: The Third Doctor
oracle_text:
Trample

name: Emergent Sequence
oracle_text: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. That land becomes a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature that's still a land. Put a +1/+1 counter on it for each land you had enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
